inputs.text: Listen, this story from JFK International Airport in New York on Thursday really shows what strong authority and duty look like in practice. An Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent stepped in without hesitation when a baby in a crowded TSA line with his family stopped breathing. The Department of Homeland Security released video footage of the agent holding the child, spotting the crisis, and taking immediate action. This is the decisive responsibility we need to hold society together, protect families, and keep order when things turn chaotic and the vulnerable are exposed. These agents embody the values of personal duty and national protection that actually safeguard our children and way of life. It underscores why we must back our law enforcement and border institutions instead of tolerating progressive attacks that erode the traditions and structures keeping us secure.
